'''Vitamin mint''' was a variety of nutritious dessert eaten by [[Ken]] during his time in the [[Lost City of the Jedi]]. He grew tired of vitamin mint, however, and wished to taste real desserts like the kind ordinary kids eat.<ref name="The Lost City of the Jedi">''[[The Lost City of the Jedi]]''</ref>
